item.title: Lone bettor wins Php 19M Lotto 6/42 jackpot on December 30, 2025
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – Lone bettor bagged Php 19 million jackpot prize in the Lotto 6/42 draw on Tuesday, December 30, 2025, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced. The lucky player hit the winning combination 06-32-29-24-37-04 with a total jackpot prize of Php 19,004,723.60.
